title: THE ONE PIECE Remake by WIT Studio Begins in February 2027 With 7 Episodes, New Concept Art Revealed
content: THE ONE PIECE remake by WIT Studio will officially arrive to Netflix in February 2027, with 7 episodes confirmed for Season 1. The first season will cover approximately 50 chapters of the original story, showing up until Luffy’s meeting with Sanji at the Baratie sea restaurant.
author: Anime Corner

title: Voice Actress Satomi Akesaka Announces Marriage
content: Voice actress Satomi Akesaka announced her marriage on her X (formerly Twitter) account on Monday. Akesaka, 38, revealed that she has married a man who is not a celebrity or involved in the entertainment industry. According to her post, the two were originally "drinking buddies" who met through social gatherings.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Reveals Episode 5 Preview Trailer & Images
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 5 (Episode 71 overall) preview ahead of its May 4, 2026 premiere. Season 4 began on April 8 and ranked first in the first three of our weekly polls of the season . Studio WHITE FOX is animating.
author: Anime Corner

title: Liar Game Anime Casts Yō Taichi as Yūji Fukunaga
content: The official website for the television anime of Shinobu Kaitani 's Liar Game manga confirmed on Tuesday that Yō Taichi has joined the anime's cast as the character Yūji Fukunaga. The character appeared in the anime's fifth episode on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 6 Anime Coming to HIDIVE in May 2026
content: The second month of the exciting Spring 2026 anime season is finally here as some of the greatest anim of the year made their debut in April. The first month of the ongoing season includes some of the greatest anime ever, including Witch Hat Atelier, Nippon Sangoku , and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen’s Sequel Unveils The Only Special-Grade Sorcerer of The New Era
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Jujutsu Kaisen manga! Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo shocked fans with the tragic fate that befell Yuji Itadori, the protagonist of the original series. The main story ended in September 2024, and only a year later, the series returned with a sequel story.

title: One Piece Confirms Exciting Anime Update in Elbaph Arc
content: While the Elbaph Arc in the One Piece manga has been ongoing for a while, the anime only commenced it in April this year. The series returned after a three-month hiatus, giving the anime studio more time to prepare for the most exciting arc of the story so far.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for the television anime of Kamome Shirahama 's Witch Hat Atelier manga announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday two new cast members for the series. The characters appear in the sixth episode, which airs next Monday. Ayumu Watanabe ( Ace Attorney , Doraemon films) is directing the anime at BUG FILMS .
author: ANN

title: Cygames Acquires 3DCG/VFX Studio Griot Groove
content: Cygames announced on its Japanese website on Friday that it has acquired all shares of 3DCG animation and visual effects production house Griot Groove . The company aims to improve its current video production and quality with the acquisition.
author: ANN
